caption: Separate sampled pieces can preserve local tissue without forming a continuous map of the lesion's outer boundary. An oriented excision provides a documented boundary for evaluation; neither its outline nor visible removal supplies a margin result or proves complete clearance. Counts and shapes are fictional.

handlingNote: **Handling limit:** Real tissue can change shape. The specimen's orientation must be documented; if it is unclear, this sketch cannot supply it. Ink can also enter cracks in the tissue. The clean outline does not certify handling or a clear margin.
